title: Buddy Strings
summary: Given strings s and goal, determine if swapping any two characters in s can make it equal to goal.
statement: Given strings s and goal, determine if swapping any two characters in s can make it equal to goal. Swapping involves exchanging characters at different indices.
constraints: Swap exactly two distinct positions in s.
Return whether one swap can make s equal goal.
reference_solution:
def are_buddy_strings(s, goal):
 if len(s)!=len(goal):return False
 different=[i for i in range(len(s)) if s[i]!=goal[i]]
 return len(set(s))<len(s) if not different else len(different)==2 and s[different[0]]==goal[different[1]] and s[different[1]]==goal[different[0]]

def are_buddy_strings(s, goal):
    if len(s)!=len(goal):return False
    different=[i for i in range(len(s)) if s[i]!=goal[i]]
    if len(different)<=1:return True
    return len(different)==2 and s[different[0]]==goal[different[1]] and s[different[1]]==goal[different[0]]
hints: A successful swap yields either exactly two cross-matching mismatches, or zero mismatches with a duplicate available.
Collect mismatch indices after checking equal lengths.
Zero mismatches requires duplicate; two requires crossed characters; every other count rejects.
A swap changes at most two positions, and these cases precisely characterize whether it can preserve or repair equality.
